Question 1
?

Let F(x,y,z)=y2i−x2j+5k and let C be a path in R3. Which of the following is equivalent to ∫CF⋅dr?

a
 ∫Cy2dx−x2dy+5dz
b
 ∫C(y2−x2)dxdy+5dz
c
 ∫C(y2+x2+5)dxdydz
d
 ∫Cy2dx+x2dy
e
∫Cx2dx−y2dy+5dz
Submit
